title: DxfImportResult
description: What the import added and which texts were read from the DXF source.

matched.description: Texts matched to their DXF entity (layer and position) and stamped

rewritten.description: Texts whose stored string changed, as 'Rhino's text -> decoded text'

unmatched.description: Texts left as Rhino made them: no DXF entity on their layer within 1 mm, or two equally near

labels_suspect.description: Unmatched texts that look like a mangled \U+ escape (B00F8ttekott): reported, not guessed at

units.description: The units the DXF is drawn in

insunits.description: $INSUNITS as the file has it, null when it is missing

scale.description: Millimetres per drawing unit: the scale into the mm model

units_guessed.description: $INSUNITS was missing, 0 or not a plan unit; the units are read from the drawing's size (under 500 across is m, else mm) and a warning says so

message.description: Imported office_2D.dxf: 283 objects. Texts 16/16 read from the DXF, 1 rewritten. Units mm ($INSUNITS 4), scale ×1.
